subject.title: fix(ui): show config path in overview snapshot (Fixes #53958)

question: Should OpenClaw surface the active config path in the Overview snapshot card, move the same information to Settings/Config, or keep config-path discovery out of the UI?
rationale: The code path is narrow and uses an existing admin-scoped field, but the linked request explicitly leaves the UI location open and the change makes an absolute local path prominent in a user-facing page.

options.title: Accept Overview Row
options.body: Land this display-only approach after real running-Control-UI proof shows the admin-scoped snapshot field renders correctly.

options.title: Move To Settings Or Config
options.body: Ask for the same existing `configPath` field to be surfaced in a less prominent settings/config information area instead of Overview.

options.title: Keep CLI Only
options.body: Decline additional UI exposure and rely on the already merged CLI/config troubleshooting surfaces for path discovery.

recommendation.title: Accept Overview Row
recommendation.body: Land this display-only approach after real running-Control-UI proof shows the admin-scoped snapshot field renders correctly.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev has the clearest feature-history signal for the Overview presentation surface receiving the new row.
